camel_example: aliyun eiam SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordExpirationStatus enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx
description_en: Sets the password expiration policy for a specified Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) instance
description_zh: 设置指定EIAM实例下密码过期策略
kebab_example: aliyun eiam set-password-expiration-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-expiration-status enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The password expiration configuration status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
密码过期配置状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：开启。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: password_expiration_status

parameters.help_en: The validity period of a password, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled
parameters.help_zh: 密码有效时长，单位是天。当PasswordExpirationStatus取值为enabled时必传
parameters.name: password_valid_max_day

parameters.help_en:
The action to take when a password expires. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
forbid_login: Prohibit logon.
force_update_password: Force password change.
remind_update_password: Remind to change password
parameters.help_zh:
密码过期动作。当PasswordExpirationStatus取值为enabled时必传，取值可选范围：
forbid_login：禁止登录。
force_update_password：强制修改密码。
remind_update_password：提醒修改密码
parameters.name: password_expiration_action

parameters.help_en:
The password expiration notification status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
密码过期通知状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：开启。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: password_expiration_notification_status

parameters.help_en: The list of password expiration notification channels. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled
parameters.help_zh: 密码过期通知渠道列表，当PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus取值为enabled时必传
parameters.name: password_expiration_notification_channels

parameters.help_en: The password expiration notification time, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled
parameters.help_zh: 密码过期通知时间，单位是天。当PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus取值为enabled时必传
parameters.name: password_expiration_notification_duration

parameters.help_en: The forced password change time, in days. The value of this parameter must be greater than the value of PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration
parameters.help_zh: 密码强制修改时间，单位是天。当前字段取值要比PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration大
parameters.name: password_forced_update_duration

parameters.help_en: The list of effective authentication source IDs
parameters.name: effective_authentication_source_ids
